title: The volume of the 9D ball is a rational multiple of a 1D spectral trace

statements.text: The inverse-square spectral trace of the Laplace operator on a circle and the volume of the nine-dimensional unit ball share the factor $\pi^4$, giving the exact rational identity $V_9 = \frac{64}{21} \mathrm{Tr}(\Delta^{-2}) = \frac{32 \pi^4}{945}$.

sources.quote: It establishes an exact holographic identity linking discrete trace-class spectral invariants of a one-dimensional Laplace operator on a circle to the continuous geometric volume of a nine-dimensional Euclidean unit ball
